text:
alex: Heads-up — we’re seeing a spike of ~12% 5xx from the hosted-inference API in eu-west for the last 8m. Multiple support tickets (Acme, BetaCo) reporting timeouts and billing/partial-response failures. Opening a triage thread here.

deploy-bot: deploy succeeded: hosted-inference v1.12.4 -> v1.12.5 at 2026-03-18T01:03:12Z (cd pipeline #deploy-984) :package:

jenny: Observing a lot of 504/502 in the gateway logs pointing at runtime-pool-eu-west. Short log sample:
```
gateway: upstream response 504 for /v1/generate client_id=acme seq_len=1536
runtime: connect timeout to runtime-3 (10.5s) kv_cache.get latency=120ms
```

mike: I can repro locally in prod-sim with a seq_len > 1024. curl hangs then gateway 504 after ~30s. Repro steps: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"input":"<>"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer ...'` (will attach recorded request).

sara: Are we sure this is the new runtime deploy? we had retries added in outbound proxy a week ago.

alex: Don’t rollback yet. Quick mitigation plan: 1) scale runtime pool in eu-west, 2) enable per-tenant fallback to the smaller model variant for high-seq requests, 3) temporarily increase gateway timeout to 60s while we stabilize. Sam, can you scale and flip fallback?

sam: Scaling now — bumping runtime-pool-eu-west from 6 -> 12 instances. Also enabling per-tenant fallback for top 10 noisy tenants. ETA ~2m.

oncall-bot: autoscaler: scaled group runtime-pool-eu-west -> 12 instances (action by sam)

support-runbook: Playbook snippet — notify impacted customers, provide temporary quota increases (if they were throttled), flag billing anomalies to finance team, and ask customers to retry. Use canned message `INCIDENT_TEMP_FALLBACK_V1`.

jenny: After scale + fallback, 5xx rate dropped to ~1.6% and p95 latency improved from 4.2s -> 1.4s in eu-west. Metrics (approx): 5xx: 12% -> 1.6%, p95: 4.2s -> 1.4s, erroring tenants reduced from 12 -> 2.

mike: I’m seeing a KV cache miss storm around the spike window; `kv_cache.get` latency jumped and the runtime timed out waiting on remote store. Snippet: `kv_cache.get key=prefix:session:... latency=118ms errors=430` — suspect prefetch change in the new runtime image.

alex: Good catch. Action items: jenny -> investigate runtime prefetch/kv change and correlate with deploy, sam -> add e2e test for long-seq paths and add a guard in the deploy pipeline, mike -> produce reproducible minimal test case and attach to INF-3421, support-runbook -> draft customer comms and refund guidance if billing anomalies confirmed. I’ll own follow-up comms with Sales.

jenny: Created INF-3421 in JIRA (link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-3421) with initial logs and hypothesis.

alex: We’ll keep this thread as the operational record until INF-3421 has the root cause. If anyone sees a regression, post updates here. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

sara: Adding one note — we should add an automatic circuit that routes >1k seq_len requests to fallback model while we fix the root cause. I’ll file a small RFC for that.

alex: Agreed. Closing active triage in this channel — moving tracking to INF-3421. If you need to escalate reopen here.
